prompt: Write a note to a friend about what your team delivered over the last year and a bit. Aim for about 400 words. Reply with the note only.
final_message:
Hi [Friend's name],

It's been a while, so here's a catch-up on what our team has been up to over the past year and a bit. I'm writing it from memory, so I've left brackets where the specifics go.

The biggest piece was [major project]. When we started in [month/year], [describe the problem or starting point]. After [number] months of work, we shipped it in [month]. The result is [concrete outcome, e.g. faster load times, fewer support tickets, a new customer segment]. I'm proud of it, mostly because [reason: it was hard, it was a team effort, it changed how we work].

The second thing was [second deliverable]. It was smaller in scope but mattered a lot day to day. It [what it did or fixed]. People had complained about [pain point] for a long time, so it felt good to finally close that out.

We also did some less visible work. We [e.g. paid down technical debt, improved testing and monitoring, documented processes, moved to a new platform]. Nobody throws a party for that kind of thing, but it's why the later launches went more smoothly than the early ones.

Not everything went to plan. [Project or milestone] slipped by [time] because [honest reason]. We learned [lesson], and it changed how we plan and scope work. I think we're better for it.

The team changed too. [Name] joined and has already [contribution]. [Name] moved on to [new role or place], and we miss them. We've also settled into a rhythm of [e.g. weekly demos, shorter planning cycles, async updates] that works for us.

Looking ahead, we're focused on [next big goal], with a first milestone around [date]. It's ambitious, but I think we've earned some confidence from the last year.

Enough about work. How are you doing? I'd love to hear what you've been up to, and I'd like to catch up properly. Are you free for coffee or a call in the next few weeks? Let me know what works.

Take care,
[Your name]
